orchid.name: 01 · Orchid dusk
orchid.note: Lavender, orchid and peach. Closest to your current purple, with a warmer illuminated edge.

lagoon.name: 02 · Tidal opal
lagoon.note: Deep teal, sea glass and lilac. Cooler and quieter, with a pearlescent ring.

ember.name: 03 · Rose ember
ember.note: Plum, rose and amber. Warmest of the four; the strongest connection to the flower reference.

aurora.name: 04 · Blue hour
aurora.note: Indigo, periwinkle and mint. More celestial, with a cool luminous rim.
